<script>
PROPS = ("spring.version", "spring-security.version", "spring-batch.version")
MANAGED = (("org.springframework", "spring-context"), ("org.springframework", "spring-webmvc"),
           ("org.springframework.security", "spring-security-config"),
           ("org.springframework.security", "spring-security-web"),
           ("org.springframework.batch", "spring-batch-core"))


def fix(p):
    for path in p.files("**/pom.xml"):
        pom = p.pom(path)
        changed = []
        for g, a in MANAGED:
            if pom.has_dependency(g, a):
                versions = [d.get("version") for d in pom.dependencies()
                            if d.get("group_id") == g and d.get("artifact_id") == a]
                if any(versions) and pom.set_dependency_version(g, a, None):
                    changed.append(f"{a}: version dropped (parent-managed)")
        for key in PROPS:
            if pom.get_property(key) is not None and pom.remove_property(key):
                changed.append(f"property {key} removed")
        if changed:
            pom.save()
            for c in changed:
                p.log(f"{path}: {c}")
</script>
